'''xcshort Hunt Down The Rebel Fleet''' is a [[Dark]] constructed list published on [[Game Players Network]].

== Deck info ==
* '''Player:''' [[xcshort]]
* '''Published:''' 7 May 2003 (Game Players Network)
* '''GPN category:''' Standard
* '''Format:''' [[Premiere - Theed Palace]]
* '''Side:''' [[Dark]]
* '''Starting Card:''' {{CardLink|Hunt Down And Destroy The Jedi / Their Fire Has Gone Out Of The Universe|SE-D-huntdownanddestroythejedi.gif|label=Hunt Down And Destroy The Jedi}}
* '''Strategy:''' Hunt Down And Destroy The Jedi
* '''GEMP Importable deck:''' [[Media:PTheed HD xcshort DS 2003 GPN.txt |Download]]

Intended For Space Battles mainly

== Strategy ==

Basically Use the Dark Jedi to Calm any Ground battle and fight in space.  Use Commander Gherant to get out the rest of the Executor sites. Then use the You Cannot Hide Forever& Mobilization Points to get the Executor if not already in play then lose the effect to get Flagship Opperations.  Start deploying TIE Intercepter and deploying capitals to their locations.

Can I have more constructive statements please.  I tried to modify the deck and it wouldn't let me I realized that it wasn't what I wanted to display.
